---
title: "Lab: Linear regression II: multiple predictors & model building"
---

**Data:** NHANES: systolic BP ~ age + BMI + sex + smoking

## Learning goals
- Fit and interpret a multiple regression
- Present crude and adjusted estimates in one table
- Interpret a categorical predictor and an interaction
- Compare candidate models and justify a choice
